capabilities: Convert full-line hyphen input (4+ hyphens plus Enter) into a timestamped divider
Render --- *YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm* lines as a rule with a centered timestamp in Reading view and Live Preview
Leave standard --- rules and code blocks unchanged
Show the raw source line in Live Preview while the cursor is on it for editing and deletion
disambiguation: Not a timestamping tool for notes or headings; it only turns long dashed divider lines into timestamped horizontal rules.
extras: README includes a full Chinese-language section (rules and manual installation) alongside the English one; installation is manual via GitHub Releases.
problem: Obsidian's standard Markdown horizontal rule carries no timestamp, so there is no built-in way to make a divider that records when it was created.
summary: Rule-based formatting plugin that converts a full line of four or more hyphens into a timestamped horizontal divider in Reading view and Live Preview.
